title: Simulating Reads for Detection of Transportable Element Insertions
author: Qichao Yu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.imrcc56

steps.title: Select Random Transportable Elements (TEs)
steps.instruction: Generate N random numbers from 1 to M nonredundantly to select TEs (where N=761 and M=2852).

steps.title: Select Target Autosomes
steps.instruction: Generate X random numbers from 1 to 22 nonredundantly to determine the number of autosomes picked up for TE insertion.

steps.title: Assign TEs to Autosomes
steps.instruction: Assign the N selected TEs to the X chosen autosomes proportionably based on the lengths of the autosomes.

steps.title: Determine Insertion Positions
steps.instruction: For each of the X autosomes, generate a corresponding number of random numbers from 1 to the length of the chromosome to define the TE insertion positions.

steps.title: Create Modified FASTA File
steps.instruction: Insert the TE sequences into the specified positions of the specific autosomes in order to produce a new FASTA file named hg19_TE.fasta.

steps.title: Run PIRS Simulation
steps.instruction: Run PIRS using the resulting FASTA file with the following command line: "pirs -i hg19_TE.fasta -o output.fastq.prefix -x 60".
